contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [DN VALE]N S PF AVG ; R/ [SECURI]TAS REI PVBLICAE

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Valens (364-378), Victory left issue of 364-378, Reece period 19. Possibly Siscia mint. Chipped. Obverse description: Bust draped and diademed right. Obverse inscription: [DN VALE]N S PF AVG. Reverse description: Victory advancing left with wreath and palm; star over crescent in left field. Reverse inscription: [SECURI]TAS REI PVBLICAE. In exergue: [-]MAu. Diameter:…
